title: Concept: Possible an Artifactory password passed with --artifactory-password in source
description: an Artifactory password passed with --artifactory-password written into a script ships with the repository and with every build log that echoes the command. Rotation plus removing the literal argument is the durable fix.
applicability: Shell scripts, CI job definitions, Dockerfiles, Makefiles and runbooks that may contain an Artifactory password passed with --artifactory-password.
risk: Use of the credential by anyone who can read the script, the image or the CI log; HIGH severity.
